title: fix(rest,runtime): datasource metadata reads require the same capability as the datasource admin door
body:
Fixes #21087

Clause-②: no

## What changes

Datasource metadata reads require the same capability as the datasource admin door: `manage_platform_settings`. The cached federation catalog (`external_catalog`) is held to the federation read door's capability, which is the same one.

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`: `META_TYPE_READ_CAPABILITIES` (`datasource` and `external_catalog`, both `manage_platform_settings`) and `metaTypeReadRefusal(method, type, caller)`, the one type-level read admission of the `/meta` surface. It judges `GET` and `HEAD` only. It folds the type segment through both spellings the read paths resolve a type by (`canonicalMetaUrlType`, `pluralToSingular`). It admits a caller whose resolved `systemPermissions` hold the row's capability, and answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` (no identity) or `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (message names the capability) otherwise. It reads the held set alone, with no `isSystem` arm, as the admin door does.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: asked in the guarded registrar that every `/meta` route is mounted through, right after the anonymous deny and before any handler reads the store. Written with the shared ADR-0112 `sendError` envelope.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`: asked at `handleMetadataRequest`'s entry, at the same point, so a host that mounts only the catch-all answers the same.
- `packages/rest/src/index.ts`: exports the predicate for the dispatcher.

Every read route under a listed type is judged alike: the list, the item read with each switch (`?state=draft`, `?preview=draft`, `?layers=`, `?package=`), `/published`, `/layers`, `/history`, `/audit`, `/diff` and `/references`. The answer is the same for an item that exists and for one that does not, and no store read happens first. Write routes are untouched; the save door keeps `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`.

This narrows who may read a published route, so it is a runtime permission change. No spec schema, export of `@objectstack/spec`, or response shape changes. Holders of the capability are served exactly as before; platform admins hold it through `admin_full_access`.

## Why this seam

- The per-document read gate (`createMetaItemReadGate` / `createMetaListReadGate`) is the existing per-type seam both transports share, but it runs after the store read, and several doors answer absence before it is asked. A `datasource` arm there would make the item doors an existence oracle (`403` for a name that exists, `404` for one that does not). A type-level admission at the entry cannot.
- The metadata type registry (`MetadataTypeRegistryEntrySchema`) declares no per-type read capability, and adding one would be a spec contract change. The table here names only capabilities that each type's own door already requires (matched, never minted), so it needs no new vocabulary.
- One decision, two callers: both transports ask the same predicate, as they already do for `isPublicAudienceRead`. No second route, no second resolver.

## Consumers measured

- Console (objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `e420df310`): the Setup datasource page reads `/api/v1/datasources/*` (the admin door), not `/meta/datasource`. `MetadataProvider` loads `object`, `dashboard`, `report`, `page`, `view` and `app` only. The federation panel uses `/api/v1/datasources/:name/external/*`. Nothing at the pin reads `/meta/datasource` or `/meta/external_catalog` for a member-facing surface. One generic reader can reach it: `DraftChangesPanel` lists `/meta/TYPE` to classify a pending draft, so a pending draft of either type, viewed by an author without the capability, now gets a `403` there (see acceptance notes).
- CLI: `os meta list|get TYPE` is generic and reads with the caller's own credential.
- MCP server (`packages/mcp`): exposes objects and metadata types, no datasource body.

## Bounded in-place addition: `external_catalog`

Same defect class, same mechanism, same files, one table row. The federation read door (`GET /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/tables`, `FEDERATION_READ_CAPABILITY`) admits only `manage_platform_settings` for the remote schema, and `external_catalog` stores the cached snapshot of that schema. Measured on a booted showcase after the fix (federation catalog refreshed by the admin): a signed-in member is refused by both doors (`403`), and the admin is served by both (`200`). ADR-0015 §6.2 wrote "reads require `metadata:read`" for the federation routes. The mounted reads were moved to `manage_platform_settings` by the ruling recorded on `FEDERATION_READ_CAPABILITY`, and this row applies that rule to the cached catalog. The row can be dropped in one line if the maintainer prefers a separate card.

## Tests

On `220d08037`:

- `packages/rest/src/meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` (new, 53 cases). (1) The predicate: verbs, folding, holder admitted, authoring capabilities and an unrelated grant refused, `isSystem` is no arm, unlisted types untouched. (2) Every read door, read off the route table (every `GET` under `/meta/:type`) plus the item read's four switches, for both types in both spellings: three refused callers (member, author with `manage_metadata` + `studio.access` + `setup.access`, an unrelated grant) get `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with zero store reads; the refusal is byte-identical for an existing and an absent name; a holder is served `200` on every shape; an unlisted type is served to the same callers. (3) Agreement with the datasource admin door: four principals resolved through `resolveAuthzContext` over one grant store are admitted or refused alike by `GET /datasources/:name` and `GET /meta/datasource/:name`, and only the holder is admitted.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-type-read-capability-parity.test.ts` (new, 19 cases): the dispatcher refuses member and author on list, item, `/published`, `/layers` and an absent name with zero store reads, serves the holder, and answers every caller exactly as `RestServer` does.
- Two existing fixtures read a datasource-family type and now hold the capability that read requires: `meta-unknown-type-read-refusal.test.ts` (its `external_catalogs` row) and `meta-list-protocol-fault.test.ts` (its `datasource` row).
- `@objectstack/rest`: `vitest --project local` 259 files, 5075 passed / 143 skipped; `--project repo` 1 file, 8 passed; `typecheck` (tsc + test-typecheck) exit 0.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `vitest --project local` 298 files, 4268 passed / 5 skipped; `--project repo` 3 files, 751 passed; `typecheck` exit 0.

## Reverse verification

Each leg ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), on `220d08037`, in the expected direction (turn red):

- RestServer seam removed: rest file 19 red / 34 green (every refusal row and the three refused admin-door agreement rows), runtime parity 4 red / 15 green.
- Dispatcher seam removed: runtime file 12 red / 7 green.
- `datasource` row removed: rest file 18 red / 35 green, runtime parity 4 red / 15 green; the `external_catalog` rows stay green.

Live check on a booted showcase (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, fresh SQLite, packages built at `611db071c`): a signed-in member without the capability gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on every datasource and catalog read shape, including an absent name and the plural and percent-encoded type spellings. The admin gets `200`. `object`, `app` and `view` reads by the member are unchanged (`200`).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths): 62 commands, all exit 0 on `220d08037`. `--ran` reconciliation: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The same derivation over this diff applied to `origin/main` at `fed0db8f6` gives the identical 62-command list, and the patch applies cleanly there. Two prerequisites were met before the final pass: the teardown self-test's pinned fixture commit was fetched, and the eight packages `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads were built.

Lint: CI owns `pnpm lint`. Narrowed run: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed `.ts` files reports 8 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. This repo's `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- A write-path observation on the same type family is reported to the seat for the maintainer. Not touched here: writes are outside this card.
- `GET /meta/diagnostics` serves per-type counts (a datasource count included) to every signed-in caller. Counts only, no topology. Not touched.
- `GET /meta/_drafts` lists draft identities (type, name, package) to authoring callers, with no body. Not touched.
- `DraftChangesPanel` (objectui) classifies a pending draft by listing `/meta/TYPE`. For a pending `datasource` or `external_catalog` draft viewed by an author without the capability, that list now answers `403` and the panel's fetch throws for that type.
- The datasource redaction work on another read path (#21086) is a sibling card; no redaction file and no `packages/metadata-protocol` file is touched here.
